serviceIdentity: signed serviceIds allowlist; strictly increasing Gregorian service day at each start or region import
completion: head at physical route end, speed zero, no motion segment, no movement authority
distanceMm: physical final head coordinate minus materialized head coordinate; unsigned decimal string; route changes preserve coordinate continuity
minimumSeatsProvided: minimum sum of signed physical vehicle capacities over every formation used before completion; null if any capacity is unknown
missingSeats: max(0, requiredSeats - minimumSeatsProvided), or null if either fact is unknown
missedConnections: 0 only for an explicit signed none-contracted assessment; null for unavailable
retry: per-service monotone day fence survives retirement and handover; no daily receipt accumulation
legacy: absent optional policy/binding preserves original serialized state and produces no inferred outcome
dailyReport: sum exact millimetres before kilometre conversion; signed serviceDay survives overnight completion; knownServicesComplete does not prove dayPlanComplete
settlement: requires explicit complete daily manifest, operational obligations and cost evidence; absence is never zero
